title: Elon Musk plans SpaceX stock giveaway for American children
excerpt: Elon Musk announces plans to distribute SpaceX shares to children across America next year through designated Trump Accounts.
body_html:
Elon Musk has announced plans to distribute one of his SpaceX shares to every child in America next year. President Donald Trump stated that these shares will be provided through Trump Accounts.

Musk acknowledged Brad Gerstner, a booster of the Trump Account initiative, for helping make the distribution possible. The announcement follows statements from both Musk and Trump regarding the planned allocation of the company shares to children.
